description: This file contains functions and types for interacting with the Mattermost API, including building clients, listing groups and peers, and handling account configurations.

methods.name: buildClient
methods.description: Constructs a MattermostClient instance based on provided account configuration.

methods.name: buildClients
methods.description: Builds a list of unique MattermostClient instances from all enabled accounts.

methods.name: listMattermostDirectoryGroups
methods.description: Lists visible channels (public and private) for configured bot accounts, with optional filtering and limit.

methods.name: listMattermostDirectoryPeers
methods.description: Lists team members as peer directory entries, using the first available client and team.
